newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank seen selling dollars -traders.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank seen selling dollars -traders.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank was seen selling between $5 million to $10 million in late trade at 26.37 pesos, traders said on Tuesday.
The foreign exchange market is currently jittery over possible large outflows from foreign funds due to the slump in the stock market.
"Banks are just being cautious. I haven't seen real demand for the dollar yet," a foreign bank dealer said.
Another foreign bank dealer said there were still few outflows at the moment.
The Philippine Central Bank declined to comment.
